title: Allobaculum stercoricanis and Its Postbiotics Alleviate Dextran Sulfate Sodium (DSS)-Induced Colitis through the Regulation of theTLR4/NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway.
authors: Wang, Teng; Wang, Jiantang; Huangfu, Bingxin; He, Xiaoyun; Huang, Kunlun
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究益生菌后生元缓解结肠炎，涉及代谢物与FXR的分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a chronic intestinal disorder that has become a global public health concern. Postbiotics offer advantages in biosafety and reproducibility over probiotics. Here, we demonstrated that live Allobaculum stercoricanis (A. stercoricanis) and its two postbiotic preparations horizontal line inactivated bacterial cells (POST) and cell-free fermentation supernatant (CFS) horizontal line effectively alleviated dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced colitis in mice. Integrated gut microbiome and serum metabolomics analyses indicated that these interventions may act through modulating bile acid metabolism and Toll-like receptor signaling pathways. Further investigations combining postbiotic metabolomics, network pharmacology, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations identified alpha-muricholic acid (alpha-MCA) as a candidate functional metabolite, with the farnesoid X receptor (FXR) as a potential target. We hypothesize that alpha-MCA may contribute to ameliorating intestinal inflammation through engagement of FXR and suppression of the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. These findings provide new insights into postbiotic-based therapeutic strategies for IBD.
abstract_zh: 炎症性肠病（IBD）是一种慢性肠道疾病，已成为全球公共卫生关注的问题。后生元相较于益生菌在生物安全性和可重复性方面具有优势。在此，我们证明活的嗜粪别样杆菌（A. stercoricanis）及其两种后生元制剂——灭活细菌细胞（POST）和无细胞发酵上清液（CFS）——能有效缓解葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导的小鼠结肠炎。整合的肠道微生物组和血清代谢组学分析表明，这些干预措施可能通过调节胆汁酸代谢和Toll样受体信号通路发挥作用。进一步结合后生元代谢组学、网络药理学、分子对接和分子动力学模拟的研究，鉴定出α-鼠胆酸（alpha-MCA）为候选功能代谢物，并以法尼醇X受体（FXR）为潜在靶点。我们假设alpha-MCA可能通过参与FXR并抑制TLR4/NF-kappaB信号通路来改善肠道炎症。这些发现为基于后生元的IBD治疗策略提供了新见解。
